description: This plot illustrates the average performance of models across three different evaluation metrics relative to their parameter count. The x-axis is labeled "Model Size (log scale)" and employs a logarithmic scale, featuring discrete tick labels at 70m, 160m, 410m, 1.0B, 1.4B, 2.8B, and 7.0B. The y-axis is labeled "Avg. Performance (%)" and uses a linear scale with numeric ticks marked at intervals of 20, from 20 up to 80. The plot contains three solid lines, all utilizing upward-pointing triangle markers. The red line represents Precision, which begins at its highest point of approximately 78% for the 70m model, declines slightly to a low of roughly 71% at 410m, and then gradually increases to end at approximately 76% for the 7.0B model. The blue line represents Recall, demonstrating a steady upward trend from its lowest point of approximately 8% at 70m to its highest point of roughly 45% at 7.0B. Finally, the purple line represents the F1-score, which exhibits a consistent increase across the x-axis, beginning at approximately 14% for the 70m model and rising steadily to reach roughly 56% at the 7.0B mark.
